en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 5. My father narrated to me from Sa’d ibn ‘Abdillāh, from Ya’qūb ibn Yazīd, from Ibn Abī ‘Umayr, from some of our companions, from Ibn Abī Nāb, who said: Abū ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) said:
It is an obligation on those who are poor to go to (the Ziyārah of) the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.) once a year and on those who are wealthy to go twice a year.
